questionText:
Which one of the following statements is not correct about the cultural
consequences of globalisation?

options.text:
The consequences of globalization is strictly confined to the sphere of
politics and economy.
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.

options.text:
The cultural effect of globalization leads to the fear that this process
poses a threat to cultures in the world.
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: The rise of a uniform culture is not emergence of a global culture.
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text:
What we have in the name of global culture is the imposition of Western
culture on the rest of the world.
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Cultural globalisation impacts food, attire, values, and music worldwide. Far from being confined to politics and economics, globalization exerts powerful cultural effects, creating both cultural homogenisation (spread of Western monoculture) and cultural heterogenisation (appropriation into local contexts). Thus, statement (C) is factually false.
Hence, option (A) is correct.
